segments.text: This is PolyglotFormFill. Let me show you, plainly, what it does — and why it might matter to you.

Maybe you fill the same forms again and again — for a job, a lease, a benefit you are owed. Maybe a form arrives in a language you are still learning. Or maybe you are the one in the family everyone brings their paperwork to. If any of that is you, this was built with you in mind.

Take a real form, like this one. It asks for your name, your address, your date of birth. The next form asks again. And the one after that. PolyglotFormFill remembers your details once, so the form is already filled the moment you open it.

You do not even have to type them. Photograph an ID — a licence, a passport — and it is read here on your device and turned into your profile. Nothing is uploaded. The reading happens right here, with you.
Even a flat scan — a page with no boxes to click into — is understood. It finds where each answer belongs and makes the page fillable, with no printer and no scanner.
Then the form fills itself — the name, the address, the details you would otherwise retype every single time. You look it over. You are always in control of what goes in.
Not only the typing. The choices too — a drop-down, a set of options, a box to tick — answered from what you told it just once.
A photo where the form wants a photo. Your signature on the line meant for it. Placed for you, not cut and pasted by hand.
And when a form asks something new, you answer it once. It is kept — privately, on your device — so the next form that asks already knows.
Your details are yours. But you are rarely filling only your own forms. Keep a profile for each person you help — a partner, a parent, a child — and their forms fill just as easily.
It is the same at work. A profile for each recurring form — a vendor record, an expense claim — each holding exactly the right details, filled correctly every time.
When it is ready, sign it — by hand, in whatever ink you like, or with the signature you saved earlier. Either way, it is backed by a key that lives only on your device.
And it is not only PDFs. Add the browser companion, and the forms you meet online fill the same way — from the same details, with a single click.
If a form is in a language you do not read, it is translated for you, on the spot. And the app speaks your language too — twenty-six of them.
One thing matters more than all the rest. Every bit of this happens on your device — the reading, the filling, the signing. We never see your forms, and we never see your data.
That is the whole of it — no catch. If it would make your life a little easier, it is free while we are in beta, at polyglot form fill dot mooo dot com.
